title: Causal completion reader should prefer live registration when the same run has a pending compacted survivor
outcome: A causal original completion remains readable while one run is present in both live and compacted registration maps; only distinct run identities are ambiguous, and the current live registration remains canonical.
acceptance: A behavioral test holds a real pending compaction fence so the same run exists in both maps and the authenticated original reader still returns its truthful native completion.
Distinct run ids sharing the causal selector remain refused; durable/source/authority checks are preserved.
